subject: Conditional performance roadmap and legal/HR review for Timothy Nguyen
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Flag: Timothy performance concerns + proposed next steps

Hi Irene,

Quick summary from my side — Timothy (Eng, Platform) has missed three sprint commitments, two missed code review SLAs, and we've had repeated quality regressions on the storage service over the last 10 weeks. I captured the incidents and timestamps in the attached manager_notes_summary.pdf.

I'd like to put a conditional performance roadmap in place. My current thinking: a time-limited (45–60 day) plan with 3 measurable goals, weekly 1:1 check-ins, and a clear set of deliverables. Before I draft anything for the employee, can you confirm:

- Which HR template we should use for a confidential, improvement-first PIP (I don't want to use language that reads as a termination notice)
- Any legal considerations we must address proactively (accommodation flag, disability leave, any required notice periods)
- Whether we need People Ops approval before scheduling the first meeting

I want to be careful here — Timothy previously mentioned wrist pain during a 1:1 in August and asked about flexible hours; we should confirm if he has an accommodation request that impacts the plan.

Attached: manager_notes_summary.pdf (incident log).

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Storage Platform

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Flag: Timothy performance concerns + proposed next steps

On 2026-11-29 08:12, Karthik wrote:
> Quick summary from my side — Timothy (Eng, Platform) has missed three sprint commitments...

Thanks for the detail and the attachment. From People Ops' perspective we'll treat this as a confidential development plan. Two immediate asks before People Ops/Legal sign-off:

1) Please outline three SMART goals you propose (specific metric, target, and how we'll measure).
2) Provide the evidence bundle (PR links, sprint tickets, CI logs).

I am attaching PIP_template_v2.docx (editable). This version uses neutral, coaching-first language and includes an explicit accommodation section. Markus, please review the template for any legal redlines — specifically on wording about potential next steps if outcomes aren't met, and the timing of escalation to termination.

Link to workspace (read-only): https://drive.redwood/workspace/PeopleOps/Timothy-PIP-draft

If there's an accommodation request, we should pause finalizing the formal document and open an accommodation assessment. Lauren, can you confirm the People Ops reviewer for accommodation cases?

Irene
People Operations

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Flag: Timothy performance concerns + proposed next steps

Irene —

Thanks. Below is my proposed plan (first draft) that I will finalize after legal/HR feedback. I also attached evidence_bundle.zip with PR links and ticket IDs.

Timeline: 45 days from first meeting (Day 0 = meeting date).

Goals (measurable):
1) Reduce code review turnaround time for Timothy's PRs to <24 hrs on 90% of PRs within 30 days (measure: average review lag using GitHub timestamps).
2) No critical/regression-level bugs attributed to Timothy's work in the next 45 days (measure: post-merge incidents, SLO violation attribution).
3) Deliver two production-ready bug fixes assigned in Sprint N+1 with passing e2e tests and peer sign-off (measure: merged PRs + CI status).

Support & cadence:
- Weekly 30-minute check-ins with me + written progress notes (1 page) after each check-in.
- Pairing sessions twice per week for first two weeks.
- Clear acceptance criteria on assigned tickets.

Accommodation note: Timothy mentioned wrist pain last quarter and informally asked about flexible hours — I don't have a formal accommodation request. If HR advises to open an assessment, we'll pause formalizing the PIP until that's resolved.

Attaching: evidence_bundle.zip (PR links, ticket list, incident timeline).

Karthik

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Flag: Timothy performance concerns + proposed next steps — legal review

Irene / Neha / Karthik,

Reviewed initial draft and the proposed goals. High-level legal guidance:

- Avoid definitive language that presumes termination. Use conditional language (e.g., "If the objectives are not met, further action may be considered consistent with company policy").
- Document all coaching and steps taken; retention of notes for 7 years per our evidence retention policy is suggested for cases that may lead to separation.
- If an accommodation is requested, the interactive process must begin immediately; do not finalize or present a PIP that would put the employee at a disadvantage related to the accommodation.
- Do not set arbitrary or punitive timelines; the 45-day window is acceptable if it is paired with documented support.

Attached are legal_redlines.docx with recommended wording tweaks and a short checklist for managers (what to document, who to loop in, escalation timeline). Also flagging that any performance metrics tied to team-level outages should include peer verification to reduce bias.

Markus
General Counsel

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized conditional roadmap + scheduling employee meeting

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. I've incorporated Markus' redlines into final_PIP_template.pdf and added a short manager_script.txt to guide the first meeting. Per policy: we will open a confidential HR case and add a notation of the accommodation inquiry so we have a record. That does not automatically trigger leave — it's just the start of an assessment.

Summary of steps I approved:
- Use the 45-day conditional roadmap as proposed by Karthik with the three measurable goals.
- Weekly 30-min check-ins; People Ops will join the first and final check-in.
- Manager to send calendar invite for Day 0 meeting. HR will prepare a private folder for the evidence bundle.

I am attaching final_PIP_template.pdf and manager_script.txt. Please keep content confidential.

Proposed Day 0 meeting slots: Dec 3, 10:00–10:30 PST or Dec 3, 14:00–14:30 PST. Karthik — please pick and send the invite; I'll be on the first call.

Neha
People Operations Lead

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Hi Timothy,

I wanted to schedule a short meeting to discuss a focused development plan and next steps to support your work on the storage service. The meeting is intended to be constructive and collaborative — Neha from People Ops will join.

Proposed time: Dec 3, 10:00–10:30 PST. Please let me know if that works or if you need an alternative. If you require any accommodation to participate (different time, remote setup, breaks), please tell me or HR and we'll make adjustments.

Agenda (10 min): context + goals; (15 min): proposed 45-day development roadmap; (5 min): next steps and Q&A.

Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood/event/meet-12345

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Storage Platform
